title: Move the mailbox-id validation and echo helpers out of src/mailboxes.rs
outcome: MAILBOX_ID_ECHO_CHARS, mailbox_id_echo, decode_mailbox_relay_locator and require_canonical_mailbox_id live in a small mailbox-id module, or beside valid_mailbox_relay_id in src/mailbox_relay_protocol.rs, with a provenance header. The move is pure, with behaviour unchanged, and src/mailboxes.rs stops growing past about 4,300 lines.
acceptance: Move the mailbox-id validation and echo helpers out of src/mailboxes.rs is done
